source.interpretation: Resolved source door tables, same-area defaults, cross-area door destinations and event-based destination overrides.

limits: Extracted from the public reference decompilation, not byte-for-byte verified against the user's exact AMTE ROM.
This is the source game's room topology mapped onto the seven creative neighbourhood levels; it is not yet the redesigned final route topology.
Door coordinates are source-room block coordinates. Geometry, clipdata, camera bounds, spawn positions and gameplay affordances still need room-specific extraction.
Event names remain source constants; their conditions and story meaning need adaptation into the project narrative.
